title: Bespoke title treatment / Earth Day

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Give a topic a distinctive typographic shape so the headline reinforces its meaning.
strategic_value: Circular reuse language can make Instagram’s Earth Day communication recognizable and relevant to the occasion.
demonstration: Lime Reduce Reuse Reshare lettering forms a ring over a portrait, with a small Earth Day message below.
practical_value: Use a shaped title when the form adds meaning and the supporting message remains easy to read.

content_islands.name: Portrait field
content_islands.spec: Fill the tall frame with the blue-clothed subject and flowers.

content_islands.name: Circular title and support
content_islands.spec: Wrap the lime words in a ring around the subject and align the smaller message at lower left.

reference_purposes.Expression: Circular lettering creates a bespoke title treatment.
reference_purposes.Application: The reuse phrase is applied to an Earth Day campaign.
